title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - PresetAdjustingTime
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/PresetAdjustingTime. This class represents the parameters that are needed by a clock to modify its time. Subclass of SAREF4GRID's own ComplexActionOperationInput; inherits obtainInputFromObis (documented on the CosemOperationInput model and not repeated here).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PresetAdjustingTime'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasPresetTime.description: Property. It pre-sets the clock time to a new value.

hasValidityIntervalStart.description: Property. It defines the start of a validity interval within which the new time can be activated.

hasValidityIntervalEnd.description: Property. It defines the end of a validity interval within which the new time can be activated.
